Asymptotic DNN weights from ranks (full U-statistic, WOR)

dnn_weights_asymp_full_from_ranks.Rd

Compute asymptotic DNN (k-NN) weights via the L-statistic representation over the full U-statistic of order s, using Beta order-statistic increments as an approximation to the exact finite-population law.

Usage

dnn_weights_asymp_full_from_ranks(ranks, k, s, normalize = TRUE)

Arguments

ranks

Integer permutation of 1:n; ranks[i] is the global rank of obs i.

k

Integer, number of nearest neighbors used inside each s-subset; must satisfy 1 <= k <= s.

s

Integer, U-statistic order (subset size); must satisfy 1 <= s <= n.

normalize

Logical; if TRUE (default) renormalizes weights to sum exactly 1 (guards roundoff).

Value

A list with

  • w: numeric length-n weights in data order (sum to 1).

  • w_rank: numeric length-n weights in rank order (1..n).

  • meta: list with n, k, s, approx = "beta(OrderStat)".

Details

Unlike the exact finite-population rule, this asymptotic approximation is evaluated on the full rank grid 1:n and is therefore typically treated as a full-support rank-weight sequence.

Examples

set.seed(1)
n <- 50
s <- 10
k <- 3
ranks <- sample.int(n)
out <- dnn_weights_asymp_full_from_ranks(ranks, k = k, s = s)
sum(out$w) # 1
#> [1] 1
sum(out$w_rank) # 1
#> [1] 1
